periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the black eye patches is oriented diagonally at approximately a 45-degree angle, sloping downward from the lateral temple toward the medial muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an oval aspect ratio, with the vertical height being significantly greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a visible downward tapering effect where the lowest point of the patch is elongated towards the snout, creating a teardrop-like inferior shift.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the dorsal band displays a wide, shallow U-shaped curvature across the upper back.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is thick and prominent, covering the entire shoulder and upper scapular region, occupying approximately one-third of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely spaced at the top of the cranium, with the gap between them roughly equivalent to 2.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The top boundaries of the ears are smoothly rounded and semicircular, showing no signs of flattening or notches.

other_distinctive_markers: The white fur on the cranial and neck regions displays a distinct yellowish-beige tint that contrasts with the brighter white fur on the ventral/chest area.
